# Indikator 9

**Indikator 9** is a quality indicator used in the Danish ADHD-databasen (ADHD database) to track how many adult treatment courses that were assessed as needing psychotherapy actually resulted in the patient receiving psychotherapy under an ADHD pakkeforløb (ADHD treatment package) within one year of treatment start [^src1][^src2]. It is one of eleven quality indicators reported in the ADHD database's annual report covering the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, and it belongs to a set of four indicators (Indikator 8–11) that, for the first time, address adult patients with an ADHD diagnosis — meaning the results are presented without any historical comparison [^src1].

Indikator 9 was put into operation on 1 April 2024 [^src2][^src1], and because of this late start, the annual report could not capture a full year of follow-up for the entire population measured; the reporting period effectively only covers patients whose treatment course began between 1 April 2024 and 31 July 2024 [^src2]. The indicator is calculated and reported through the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]], which collects data submitted by all regions and departments [^src2].

The results were strikingly low. Nationally, 786 patients had reached the one-year follow-up mark for whom psychotherapy was deemed relevant, but the indicator was only fulfilled for 10 of them — just 1% [^src2][^src1]. This is reported explicitly as an overall fulfillment rate of "1 (1-2) %" for the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 [^src1], far below the indicator's development target (udviklingsmål) of ≥90% [^src2]. The steering group behind the report attributed part of the shortfall to structural constraints in the treatment system: Region Hovedstadens Psykiatri (RHP) noted that the current ADHD treatment package, comprising only 9 hours, is not large enough in scope to incorporate psychotherapy [^src3].

Given the very low starting point, the steering group decided to keep Indikator 9 in the indicator set but to deprioritize its full implementation for now. Instead, focus is first being directed at bringing [[indikator-8|Indikator 8]] closer to its own fulfillment target before serious efforts are made to implement Indikator 9 [^src2]. This decision situates Indikator 9 within a broader story told in the annual report: most of the eleven ADHD quality indicators — including [[indikator-10|Indikator 10]] and [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]], the other new adult-focused measures — fall well short of the 90% development target, underscoring systemic gaps in ADHD diagnosis and treatment access across the Danish healthcare system.

## Claims

**Observation**
- Indikator 8-11 vedrører voksne med en ADHD-diagnose. Det er første gang denne patientgruppe og tilhørende indikatorer og resultaterne præsenteres derfor uden historik [^src1]

**Performance**
- Indikator 9 opfyldelse var 1 (1-2) % for perioden 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025 [^src1]
- Blandt de 786 patienter var indikatoren kun opfyldt for 10 patienter (1%) [^src1]

**Procedural**
- Indikator 9 blev sat i drift den 1. april 2024 [^src1]

**Epidemiological**
- På landsplan havde 786 patienter et års opfølgning for hvem psykoterapi var relevant [^src1]

**Quality-indicators**
- Udviklingmålet for Indikator 9 er ≥90% [^src1]

**Decision**
- Indikatoren bibeholdes, og fokus rettes først og fremmest mod at få indikator 8 nærmere dens opfyldelsesgrad inden indikator 9 for alvor søges implementeret [^src1]

## Timeline

- 1. april 2024: Indikator 9 blev sat i drift [^src2]
- 1. april 2025 - 31. juli 2025: Opfølgningsperiode for Indikator 9 i årsrapporten [^src2]
